description: Advanced Cloud ERP, CRM, Accounting & Operations Suite (inspired by BizimHesap and modern enterprise software), featuring automated e-commerce sync, B2B portal, warehouse, manufacturing BOM, barcode management, and an AI Financial Advisor.
theme_decision: Professional SaaS Clean Theme with Sophisticated Dark/Light Palette. Deep Slate Obsidian (#0F172A) headers/sidebar, crisp neutral backgrounds (#F8FAFC), emerald financial accents (#10B981), and electric indigo primary highlights (#6366F1).
modules: E-Ticaret Entegrasyon Merkezi (Trendyol, Hepsiburada, Amazon, Shopify, WooCommerce)
Kargo Entegrasyonları (Yurtiçi, Aras, MNG kargo fişi & barkod)

surface_strategies.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (#E2E8F0), no harsh shadows, hover lift (-translate-y-0.5) with soft shadow
surface_strategies.headers: Crystal Glass backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200/80 sticky z-50
surface_strategies.tables: Clean structured layout with sticky header, alternating rows or hover highlights, pill badges for statuses

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully functional, gorgeous, high-performance React SaaS ERP application inspired by BizimHesap with advanced modules.
Ensure all 12 modules are fully interactive with robust mock data, state management, search filters, modal forms, and live calculations.
Implement the AI Financial Advisor chat & insights box that provides cash flow forecasting and instant automated answers.
Include Multi-Company switcher in the top header bar.
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, and tables include appropriate data-testid attributes for testing.
Use Lucide icons for clean, modern iconography.
Use Sonner for toast notifications on successful actions (e.g. 'Fatura başarıyla kesildi', 'Trendyol siparişleri senkronize edildi', 'Stok güncellendi').
